strings.string: The Setup Wizard will install [ProductName] [ProductVersion] on your computer. Click Next to continue or Cancel to exit.
Please read the following license agreement carefully.
I &accept the terms in the License Agreement
Click Next to install to the default folder or click Change to choose another folder.
Click Install to begin the installation. Click Back to review or change any installation settings. Click Cancel to exit the wizard.
Please wait while the Setup Wizard installs [ProductName]. This may take several minutes.
Click the Finish button to exit the Setup Wizard.
Your system has not been modified. To install this program at a later time, please run the installation again.
Because of an error, [ProductName] setup could not be completed. Your system has not been modified.
Are you sure you want to cancel [ProductName] installation?
The wizard allows you to repair or remove [ProductName]. Click Next to continue or Cancel to exit.
Select the operation you want to perform.
Repairs errors in the most recent installation by fixing missing files and registry entries.
